idea-plugin.description:
Send selected code to JetBrains Air — with the file name and line numbers already attached.

No more switching windows, copying code, and typing "this is from file X line Y". Select the code, press the shortcut, and start asking your question.

How to use

  1. Select any code in the editor.
  2. Press Alt+Shift+A (macOS: ⌥⇧A), or right-click → Send to Air.
  3. The open Air session (or a new one, if none is open) gets the chat input pre-filled:
    @file:UserService.kt [lines from 42 to 58]
  4. Type your question and press Enter.

You can also send files and folders: select them in the Project view (⌘1 / Alt+1), then press the same shortcut or right-click → Send to Air. Each one is inserted as @file:src/Main.kt or @folder:src/checkout/.

Terminal-based sessions such as Claude Code are supported too: the reference is pasted into the agent's terminal in its own format, e.g. @src/UserService.kt#L42-58.

The message is inserted but not sent automatically — you can review and add context before submitting.

How to change the shortcut

  1. Open Settings → Keymap.
  2. Search for Send to Air.
  3. Double-click → Add Keyboard Shortcut → press your keys → OK.

Requirements

  • The JetBrains Air plugin must be installed and enabled.
  • Works in JetBrains IDEs version 2026.2 or newer (the versions Air supports): IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, GoLand, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, Android Studio.

action.description: Insert a reference to the selected code, files or folders into the Air chat
